title: Start with a taste. Stay for the story.
intro: One bowl can change how you remember a place. Begin with these three stories, or follow an ingredient, a cooking method or a region below.
feature_title: Three conversations to take to the table

features.title: A ladleful, and a question.
features.text: Choose one vegetable to notice, then ask about the lentil and seasoning. The dalma story follows an everyday bowl into different preparations and the calendar of Kartika.

features.title: Let the bowl change as you taste.
features.text: Try a little of the soft dahibara, then the potato and gravy, then bring them together. The Cuttack story invites a tasting game and a memory rather than a contest for the best vendor.

features.title: Follow the mustard.
features.text: Look beyond the golden gravy. The fish story asks where the fish came from and compares a bowl of larger pieces with a documented small-fish preparation.

paths.title: The everyday table
paths.text: Elephant apple, badi and ripe palm fruit: small dishes with stories to tell.

paths.title: Follow the fire
paths.text: Roasted vegetables, leaf parcels and browned edges. Notice what heat changes.

collection.title: Odisha · Three tastes to remember
collection.text: Keep Dalma, Dahibara Aloodum and Machha Besara together. Choose your own places and dates, add notes, then carry the stories in a tour book.
